strengths: Clear minuet phrase rhythm with 4+4+4+1 bar grouping
Modulates to dominant (D major) in second strain with F# leading tone
Ends with authentic cadence on tonic G
issues: Second strain lacks repeat ending structure—final bar G3 is only 1 bar while first strain has 8 bars, creating severe formal imbalance
Voice-leading error in bar 10: D/F/A to D is parallel fifths skeleton (F#-A-D would be proper dominant)

Bar 9 D/F/A is notated as chord but D major triad in first inversion is stylistically awkward for single-line baroque melody; also the |:|| implied repeat structure is malformed ABC (missing :| after bar 8)
suggestions: Expand second strain to 8 bars matching first strain, adding a consequent phrase after bar 12 before final cadence
Replace bar 10 D/F/A chord with single melodic line D-F#-A or A-F#-D to clarify voice-leading
Add proper repeat syntax :| after bar 8 and adjust final bar to | G3 :| or write out full second strain without repeats
critic.summary: A promising minuet skeleton with correct key and cadential aim, but critically undermined by a 1-bar second strain that collapses the binary form; the ABC syntax and harmonic voice-leading need revision for baroque credibility.
